controles.affirmation: Le BPA a chute de 42,7% au T2 2026 en partie parce que le regulateur lui a ordonne de rembourser 207 M$ / ce remboursement de 207 M$ pese directement sur le resultat du T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Operating Revenues decreased $386 million ... Generation Revenues decreased $387 million due primarily to a net decrease of $450 million due to MTM losses in 2026 as compared to MTM gains in 2025 ... a net decrease of $25 million primarily due to the conclusion of ZEC sales in May 2025
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q attribue la chute du T2 2026 a un ecart de valorisation mark-to-market de 450 M$ (pertes en 2026 contre gains en 2025), plus 25 M$ lies a la fin des ventes de ZEC en mai 2025. Le remboursement de 207 M$ n'est cite nulle part comme un facteur du resultat du trimestre : le 10-Q precise que 'ZEC revenue has been adjusted by the estimated production tax credit (PTCs)', donc la reduction etait deja comptabilisee, le versement de mai 2026 etant un reglement en tresorerie. Reecrire le hook sans ce lien de causalite.

controles.affirmation: le repli de marge operationnelle est concentre sur ce trimestre precis via le remboursement ZEC/PTC de 207 M$
controles.verbatim_source: meme passage : 'a net decrease of $450 million due to MTM losses in 2026 as compared to MTM gains in 2025'
controles.correction_proposee: Attribuer le repli a la variation mark-to-market des positions commodites, non au remboursement ZEC/PTC.

controles.affirmation: la BPU a juge que la reception des PTC constitue une double perception et a ordonne le remboursement des EDC, reverse aux clients sur environ 12 mois a partir de juin 2026 ; PSEG Power a rembourse environ 207 M$
controles.verbatim_source: The BPU determined that the receipt of the PTCs by the nuclear owners constitutes a double payment under New Jersey's ZEC legislation. The BPU ordered the nuclear owners to refund all the EDCs in May 2026, and for the EDCs to refund their respective share of the PTC refunds to customers over approximately a 12-month period beginning June 1, 2026 ... PSEG Power refunded the EDCs approximately $ 207 million as per the BPU's order.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q precise aussi que la BPU a approuve en mai 2026 un remboursement de 166 M$ aux seuls clients de PSE&G, sur les ZEC de l'annee civile 2024. Preciser le perimetre.

controles.affirmation: verbatim PTC 'Until additional guidance is issued by the U.S. Treasury, the final realized value of the PTC is subject to adjustment... PSEG did not record any PTCs for any of its nuclear units in 2025', attribue au 10-Q T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: final realized value of the PTC is subject to adjustment, which may be material. PSEG did not record any PTCs for any of its nuclear units in 2025 as gross receipts exceeded the level at which we would receive PTCs. (10-K FY2025, PEG_2026-02-26)
controles.correction_proposee: Contenu exact mais SOURCE ERRONEE : ce passage est dans le 10-K FY2025, pas dans le 10-Q T2 2026. Le 10-Q dit seulement 'ZEC revenue has been adjusted by the estimated production tax credit (PTCs) ... that adjustment could be material'. Corriger la citation.
